en: The postcard is a black-and-white image depicting a landscaped park scene with prominent trees, a domed pavilion with columns (known as the Erdbeertempel), and a stately building in the background (Kurhaus). The text at the bottom identifies the location as Bad Pyrmont and specifies the Erdbeertempel (Strawberry Temple) and Kurhaus (a spa or resort building). The reverse side shows handwritten German text, a German postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich era, and a cancellation mark from Bad Pyrmont, dated 1936.
